title: The person a workspace belongs to

codes.means: the workspace has no self/self.md, the one screen read first every session
codes.fix: create self/self.md with a header carrying every required key

codes.means: self.md's header is missing a required key or leaves one empty, has kind other than self, or carries a refused key (title, last_verified)
codes.fix: add the missing key, set kind: self, and move a title: into name:

codes.means: self.md's body is longer than one screen (60 non-empty lines)
codes.fix: move detail into the facet folders under self/ and keep self.md to one screen

codes.means: a folder or file at the root of self/ is neither a default facet or root file nor declared in self/README.md, or is unreadable
codes.fix: declare it in self/README.md under ## Facets or ## Root files, or move or remove it

codes.means: a collection about the person was left in documents/collections/ instead of under its facet in self/
self.md names no standard, the bare unversioned URL written before versions existed, or another kind's standard
self.md names a version of the self standard this validator does not implement
codes.fix: install a @supersuit/self-md that implements that version, or name https://hypercontext.wiki/standards/self/v1
